info.description: MENA e-commerce operating system. Conventions: docs/05-api.md.

bearer.description: Firebase ID token or mz_live_ API key

days.description: Days whose spend was replaced by the file

unallocated.description: Spend on days with no order to carry it: still a cost, shown, never hidden

spend.description: The day's spend in the base currency

orders.description: Orders that share it (placed that day, not cancelled before shipping)

perOrder.description: Each order's share (null when no order shares it: unallocated)

fxMissing.description: Some spend is in a currency without a rate that day; not counted

byCall.description: Answered on a team call (counts for the call channel)

apiKey.description: From Bosta's dashboard (Settings → API integration); stored encrypted, never shown again

whatsappUrl.description: wa.me link with the message, to send by hand

enabled.description: Start a confirmation for every new cash-on-delivery order

waitMinutes.description: How long to wait for an answer before the next step

attempts.description: How many times the team tries before the order stays on the list as unreachable

retryMinutes.description: After "no answer", when the order comes back on the list

linkHours.description: How long a hand-sent confirm link works

enabled.description: Route each order by its risk score (E6-2); off: every cash order walks the steps above

autoMax.description: Cash orders scored at or below: confirmed without asking

botMax.description: At or below: asked in the chat (the steps above)

agentMax.description: At or below: straight to the team's calls; above: held for review (paid orders too)

call_team.description: The store's team can always call

channels.description: Channels the store can use for confirmation

confirmed.description: Confirmed (including those shipped or delivered since)

rate.description: Confirmed ÷ (confirmed + cancelled), percent with one decimal; null before anything is decided

needsTeam.description: Waiting on the team: a team call, a change, a refusal, a hold

medianMinutes.description: Median minutes from the order to its confirmation, for orders that were asked (auto-confirmed left out)

byChannel.description: Who got the answer; store = decided outside confirmation (cancelled in the store, for example)

validTo.description: Last day it applies; null = until changed

feed.description: Where daily rates come from (shown with attribution)

rate.description: 1 base = rate quote; null when missing

day.description: Day of the rate used (earlier than asked when stale)

csv.description: The file's text: a header row with date and spend, and platform (or `platform` below), optional currency and campaign

platform.description: Platform for every row when the file has no platform column

drift.description: Provider fields that changed shape (schema drift)

backfill.description: Shopify history import progress, or null

acceptUrl.description: Link to share; opening it still requires signing in with the invited email or phone

mfa.description: Signed in with a second factor (owners and admins need it in stores)

invitations.description: Pending invitations addressed to my verified email or phone

phone.description: Local or international; checked for the store's country

variantId.description: A product from the catalogue (its price unless unitPrice is given)

title.description: An item not in the catalogue (needs unitPrice)

mode.description: cod: the courier collects all; prepaid: paid in full; partial: a deposit now, the rest on delivery; bank_transfer: waits for the money unless paid

method.description: How money already paid came in (prepaid, partial, bank_transfer)

paid.description: partial: the deposit; prepaid: the total (optional); bank_transfer: the total once it arrived

after.description: When the order comes back on the call list; null after the last try

decision.description: The customer's answer on the call

triggerVariantId.description: When the order has this product; null = any order

enabled.description: Offer one more item when a customer confirms

mode.description: rules_then_auto: the owner's rules first, else what is bought together

maxDiscountPct.description: No offer is ever discounted more than this

autoDiscountPct.description: Discount on recommended offers (rules carry their own)

inWhatsApp.description: Offer in the WhatsApp chat right after the customer confirms

inCalls.description: Show the offer in the team's call script

ai.description: Let Claude choose among Mizan's candidates and write the message (no customer data is sent)

added.description: What accepted offers added, per currency

after.description: Back on the call list at

kind.description: out: template, list, text; in: quick_reply, button_reply, list_reply, text, location

action.description: out: ask or the reply sent; in: confirm, change, cancel, reason, keep, note, message, late, ignored

offerPrice.description: For one, after the discount: what the customer was shown

failure.description: Why it was not added to the store's order: not_in_store (manual order or unlinked product), unavailable (sold out, removed, order cancelled), permission (reconnect the store), failed

whatsapp.description: The store's WhatsApp number is connected and its template approved

call_auto.description: A vendor for automated calls is connected

call_team.description: The store's team can always call

channels.description: Channels the store can use for confirmation

cod.description: Cash the courier collects; from cashToCollect, never the total

duplicate.description: A likely duplicate of an earlier order of the same customer (E5-3)

balance.description: Still owed by the customer: total − paid, never below zero

hasLocation.description: A map pin exists (shown on reveal)

redacted.description: Personal data deleted at the customer's or store's request

of.description: duplicate_found / duplicate_kept: the earlier order's number

into.description: duplicate_merged: the order it was merged into

cod.description: Cash the courier collects; from cashToCollect, never the total

duplicate.description: A likely duplicate of an earlier order of the same customer (E5-3)

day.description: The order's day, store time (rules and rate of that day)

isFinal.description: Final once settled or inspected; provisional before

flags.description: fx_missing, ads_fx_missing, cost_missing, shipping_rate_missing, cod_fee_missing, payment_fee_missing, agent_cost_missing, packaging_cost_missing, return_rate_missing, estimated, awaiting_settlement

expectedNet.description: Profit if the order delivers (orders still moving); equals net otherwise

duplicateWindowHours.description: An order of the same customer with the same product within this many hours of another is a likely duplicate; 0 turns detection off (at most 7 days)

PrivacyExport.description: The customer's data compiled for a data request (JSON)

revenue.description: Money that is real: prepaid when paid, COD when delivered; less refunds

expectedNet.description: Σ orders' profit if those still on their way deliver

fixedCosts.description: Monthly fixed costs spread over the period's days

unallocatedAds.description: Ad spend on days with no order to carry it

kept.description: What the store kept: net − fixed costs − unallocated ads

keptPer100.description: Of every 100 of revenue, what was kept

previousKept.description: The same for the period before

refusalLoss.description: What refused orders lost, all costs counted

fees.description: Payment, channel and chargeback fees and packaging

breakdown.description: Where every pound of revenue went

inTransit.description: Cash to collect on parcels on their way

awaitingRemittance.description: Cash collected by couriers, not yet paid to the store

leaks.description: What is costing money or hiding it, most costly first

location.description: Shared from the phone, for the courier

cod.description: What the customer pays the courier

truncated.description: More provisional orders remain: call again

action.description: keep: both are real orders; merge: cancel this one as a duplicate of the earlier

day.description: YYYY-MM-DD in the store's time zone

amount.description: What the platform charged that day

connectionId.description: The store the ads sold for (default: the only store)

rate.description: 1 unit of the store's base currency = rate units of the quote currency

authorizeUrl.description: Send the browser here (Shopify's consent screen)

acceptUrl.description: Link to share; opening it still requires signing in with the invited email or phone

role.description: The caller's role in this store

cost.description: null until entered; 0 is a real cost

phoneNumberId.description: Phone number ID (not the phone number)

accessToken.description: A permanent system-user token with whatsapp_business_messaging and whatsapp_business_management; stored encrypted, never shown again
